editorial:
Imagine you are surfing on a beautiful, empty beach when a massive great white shark decides you are its next meal. That is exactly what happens to Nancy, a young surfer who gets stranded on a small rock just 200 yards from shore. With a nasty bite on her leg and the tide rising, she has to use every trick she knows to stay alive. The movie keeps things simple and focused, putting you right in her shoes as she battles the ocean, the clock, and a very hungry predator. It is a tight, tense survival story that never lets up.

Blake Lively carries the whole movie on her shoulders, and she does a great job making you feel every bit of fear and determination. The shark looks real enough to keep you on edge, and the pacing rarely slows down. On the downside, some of the side characters feel flat, and a few moments stretch believability. Still, if you love survival thrillers, this one is a blast. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Nancy realizes the shark is circling back for one last attack. She swims toward a floating buoy and uses a flare gun to lure the shark in close. When it lunges, she stabs it in the eye with a piece of metal, killing it. Exhausted and bleeding, she makes it to shore just as help arrives. The movie ends with her recovering and returning to surfing, proving she survived the ultimate test.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers and shark movies.
